# Third-party code

| File | Source | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qrcode.js` | [qrcode-generator](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator) by Kazuhiko Arase (`dist/qrcode.js`) | 2.0.4 | MIT (header in the file) |

Used by the web page's Share panel to draw a QR code of the page's address, with no
internet access needed. Unmodified; `tools/embed_web.py` inlines it into the page.
